gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-devanagari: Pipe-cleaner strokes with generously opened curves give Tektur a look all its own up top. Anek Devanagari settles underneath as a plain sans with tall middle zones and distinctly open mouths, easy going over long paragraphs.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-gujarati: Expressive lettering with outsized lowercase leads in Tektur, drawn with no hairlines to squint at. Anek Gujarati follows in sans, its lowercase rivaling the capitals.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Tektur draws its arms and legs at a constant width, with every curve left generously open at the terminals. Anek Gurmukhi's open-handed rounds make a sans partner that stays clean.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reaches high with a squared-off, woodblock x-height and terminals that stop far from the stem. And Tektur, with bowls and stems at one weight, supplies a distinctive display voice above it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-latin: Tektur looks like pipe-cleaner lettering. Its glyphs are traced with one thickness, so it earns its keep big and brief, while Anek Latin keeps tall lowercase held open beneath.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam keeps its lowercase close to the capitals. Tektur brings expressive, gently monotone lines that suit display, and the sans body keeps its curve tips from touching.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-odia: Expressive and distinctive, Tektur holds one stroke thickness everywhere. It is made for display, while Anek Odia is made for text, with unsealed rounds like an unlatched hook and capitals barely above lowercase.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-tamil: Distinctive outsized lowercase gives Tektur its rounded-wire look in headings, and Anek Tamil handles the text with big round bowls and half unwrapped c and s shapes in a plain sans.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-telugu: Expressive letters traced with one marker give Tektur its character, and it earns its keep big and short. Anek Telugu follows as a plain sans.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anuphan: Distinctive in a laser-cut way, Tektur cuts every letter at one width with generously opened terminals. Anuphan's big round bowls and open curves make the sans-serif partner easy to live with.
